Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwave   The response should include at least 39 pronouns.assistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's a... a... (he searches for the right words)...a genre of music.

KING
(determined)
Yes, yes, yes. Music. But also... (he snaps his fingers)...also fashion. Also... (he thinks for a moment)...also architecture.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, resplendent in a shimmering silver jumpsuit, sits on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers. They are all dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion, with neon-colored wigs, oversized sunglasses, and plenty of pastel-colored clothing.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...we must add more... more... (he searches for the right words)...more synths to our architecture.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now transformed. The buildings are adorned with neon lights, the streets are paved with a glittering, iridescent material, and the people are all dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See, my friend? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's... (he searches for the right words)...it's actually quite... quite... (he nods)...futuristic.

KING
(smiling)
I knew you'd see it my way. Now, let us... (he gestures to a nearby musician)...let us add some... (he searches for the right words)...some beats to our kingdom.

MUSICIAN
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The musician, a young woman with a bright pink wig and oversized sunglasses, begins to play a synthesizer. The music is a strange, pulsing beat, with plenty of distortion and reverb.

KING
(to his courtiers)
This is it, my friends. This is the sound of our empire's future.

COURTIER 1 (he)
(nodding)
It's... it's... (he searches for the right words)...it's actually quite... quite... (he nods)...futuristic.

COURTIER 2 (she)
(smiling)
I know, right? I love the way the synths sound.

KING
(smiling)
I'm glad you like it. Now, let us... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...let us add some... (he searches for the right words)...some fog to our kingdom.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now shrouded in a thick, misty fog. The buildings are still adorned with neon lights, the streets are still paved with the glittering, iridescent material, and the people are all still dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See, my friend? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's... (he searches for the right words)...it's actually quite... quite... (he nods)...futuristic.

KING
(smiling)
I knew you'd see it my way. Now, let us... (he gestures to a nearby musician)...let us add some... (he searches for the right words)...some beats to our kingdom.

MUSICIAN
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
